summary.text: Andrew Gerena is an independent candidate for U.S. Senate in Tennessee who describes himself as a working-class American with experience in military service, security, commercial trucking, information technology, food service and scientific research.

paragraphs.text: Gerena says his life and employment experience ranges from military service to security, commercial trucking, information technology, food service and scientific research.
He earned an associate degree from Bryant & Stratton College in 2014, and Ballotpedia lists his career experience as a technician.
He describes himself as a hiker, runner, motorcyclist and do-it-yourselfer, and says he is running with no political connections or financial support.
